description.short_caption: Hyperpigmented macules and papules on the upper back.
description.detailed_description: This clinical photograph shows the upper back of a patient with numerous small, hyperpigmented macules and papules. The lesions are scattered and appear to have a slightly rough texture. The surrounding skin is otherwise unremarkable, and there is no visible erythema or scaling. The distribution suggests a diffuse involvement of the upper back.
visible_findings: diffuse distribution on the upper back
